B33.selection_rule: Four separated RGB-visible rope locations inside the user frame0 blue circle, not posts. Initial centers refined using RGB-only bright narrow-line contrast before any new disparity reading; no replacement after statistics. IDs refer to local segment registration candidates, not proven unique material points.

tracking.method: Direct frame0 grayscale NCC of RGB context patches; reverse registration; rope-only RGB normal refinement. No optical-flow or neural model, no disparity input.
tracking.missing_policy: Failed/ambiguous locations remain null; no interpolation, smoothing, along-rope rescue, or threshold changes. Successful context registration does not prove a unique material-point identity or uncontaminated rope pixels.

B36.ROI_selection: Input RGB only; frame0/6 core rectangles reuse prior diagnosis exactly, later keyframes manually localized on RGB. All are executor diagnostic ROIs, not user-confirmed. Non-keyframe presets are null, never interpolated.

limits: No physical depth truth or paired DAVIS bokeh GT
Nominal control is not measured blur radius or actual ATB condition tensor
All new perceptual judgments are user-only
